info.title: Document Management & Collaboration API
info.description: Complete API with modular namespaces and CRUD patterns

BatchCreateResponse.description: BatchCreateResponse is the result of a batch-create operation (HTTP 207)

BatchDeleteResponse.description: BatchDeleteResponse is the result of a batch-delete operation

BatchItemResult.description: BatchItemResult is the result of a single item in a batch operation

index.description: Zero-based position of the item in the request array

success.description: Whether this item was processed successfully

resourceId.description: ID of the newly created resource (present on success)

BatchUpdateResponse.description: BatchUpdateResponse is the result of a batch-update operation

dryRun.description: True when the request was a dry run and no changes were persisted

Document.description: Document is a document managed by the system

isPublic.description: Whether the document is publicly visible

DocumentBatchCreateRequest.description: DocumentBatchCreateRequest is a batch create request for documents

continueOnError.description: Continue processing remaining items after a failure

DocumentBatchDeleteRequest.description: DocumentBatchDeleteRequest is a batch delete request for documents

confirmDeletion.description: Must be true to confirm destructive batch delete

DocumentBatchUpdateRequest.description: DocumentBatchUpdateRequest is a batch update request for documents

DocumentFilter.description: DocumentFilter contains query parameters for filtering and paginating documents

statusIn.description: Filter by one or more statuses

DocumentListItem.description: DocumentListItem is a lightweight document representation for list responses

ErrorDetail.description: ErrorDetail describes a single error in responses

field.description: Field that caused the error (if applicable)

ErrorResponse.description: ErrorResponse is a standard error envelope for all 4xx/5xx responses

PaginationMeta.description: PaginationMeta is metadata included in every list response

Team.description: Team is a team grouping users with shared access to resources

description.description: Optional description of the team's purpose

isPublic.description: Whether the team is discoverable by non-members

TeamBatchCreateRequest.description: TeamBatchCreateRequest is a batch create request for teams

continueOnError.description: Continue processing remaining items after a failure

TeamBatchDeleteRequest.description: TeamBatchDeleteRequest is a batch delete request for teams

confirmDeletion.description: Must be true to confirm destructive batch delete

TeamBatchUpdateRequest.description: TeamBatchUpdateRequest is a batch update request for teams

TeamFilter.description: TeamFilter contains query parameters for filtering and paginating teams

ownerIds.description: Filter teams by owner user ID

hasMembers.userId.description: Filter teams that include this user ID as a member

hasMembers.role.description: Filter by the member's role within the team

TeamListItem.description: TeamListItem is a lightweight team representation for list responses

User.description: User is a user account in the system

UserBatchCreateRequest.description: UserBatchCreateRequest is a batch create request for users

continueOnError.description: Continue processing remaining items after a failure

UserBatchDeleteRequest.description: UserBatchDeleteRequest is a batch delete request for users

confirmDeletion.description: Must be true to confirm destructive batch delete

UserBatchUpdateRequest.description: UserBatchUpdateRequest is a batch update request for users

UserFilter.description: UserFilter contains query parameters for filtering and paginating users

roleIn.description: Filter by one or more roles

UserListItem.description: UserListItem is a lightweight user representation for list responses
